title: Phone-viewport regional error-rate incident alert
what: eu-west peak error rate (%) or incident median error rate (%)

reader_questions.question: Which region spiked and how high did its error rate get?
reader_questions.expected: eu-west spiked to 14.3% (median ~12.3% during the incident), far above the 1.0% alert threshold.

reader_questions.question: Were us-east or ap-south affected?
reader_questions.expected: No; both stayed below 0.31% throughout the window.

reader_questions.question: Did the error rate recover after 18:28 UTC?
reader_questions.expected: Yes, eu-west decayed rapidly after minute 27–28 back toward baseline (<0.6% by 18:35).
